text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I've borrowed the student council room
today to meet with Satono
Diamond and
her parents, representatives of the Satono
Group.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Father, Mother, please meet my trainer!
There's nobody with a better
eye for
racers. If you could just give your
permission...

text_block_list.name: Dia's Father
text_block_list.text:
I respect your enthusiasm, but we can't
approve of someone we don't
know
anything about.

text_block_list.name: Dia's Father
text_block_list.text:
Your trainer will need to take a test... No, I
suppose you'll be taking it
together.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
As such, Satono, Trainer, I shall be your
examiner. You'll be racing me
one month
from now, so show me what you're capable
of.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Huh?! You're testing us, McQueen?! That's quite the tall order... But why is it you?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
It's quite simple really. I just couldn't say
no to a request from your
mother. The
distance will be the same as the Japanese
Derby—2,400
meters.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
That distance won't simply test your
accelerating abilities, but your
stamina and
pacing too. I hope you two will convince
me that you're
the perfect team.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry. When I asked you to be my
trainer, I didn't think it'd turn
out like
this...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Um, are you having second thoughts?
Challenging McQueen with me
won't be
easy...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
She's an amazing runner, and there are so
many variables in a
2,400-meter race. It
won't be easy to gain her approval.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: But I know we can do it! When you watched my running, you saw me, not my family or status. I can't reach my full potential without you!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Please! Will you share your strength—and
future—with me? We'll show
everyone
what we can do, so...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: You... really don't mind?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Our goal is clear—have Satono Diamond
win a G1 and shine at the
top of the
Twinkle Series. But for our first step, we'll
have to pass her
family's test.

text_block_list.name: Dia & Kitasan
text_block_list.text:
Yaaaaaahhh!
Haaaaaahhh!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
When Satono Diamond and I looked for a
training partner, a certain
close friend of
hers leaped at the chance.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Huff... huff... huff... huff... Let's go one more, Kita! Please!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
This isn't enough—not at all! I'll need more
than just a burst of
acceleration to keep
up with McQueen over 2,400 meters!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Dia... You're so intense... A-all right. Let's
go again!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Got it, Trainer! Keep watching me! Learn
all you can, and tell me how
to improve!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I want to be a diamond. I want to shine so
brilliantly that I burn our
family name into
history... and make my parents proud!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Huff... huff... cough, cough! Huff...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Dia... that was incredible. I mean that.
Endurance is my forte, but you
kept up
through the whole training routine.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
But Trainer, we need to stop. This is too
much for someone who hasn't
even
debuted yet.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
We were meant to debut together, but I
skipped ahead because my
body became
race-ready faster. She still can't push as
hard as I can.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I can... I can keep going, Trainer! I haven't
hit my limit yet—I'm just
being weak!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I won't be a match for McQueen unless I
do more, right? Winning as I
am now
would be a pipe dream, right?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Be honest with me. At this rate, will I stand
a chance?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I knew it...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm her partner, so I can't lie to her. I
explain her chances calmly and

objectively.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro McQueen is one of Tracen
Academy's best stayers. Meeting
her
standards in a 2,400-meter race will be far
from easy at
Diamond's current level.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I... I want to do this with you, Trainer. I
want to take on the Twinkle
Series
together.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
If we can't overcome this test together, my
dream—the Satono
family's dream—will
remain out of reach. The very dream I was
born to
achieve...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
So please! I can take it! Push me as far as it
takes to gain McQueen's
approval!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
You can't keep going, Dia! You'll hurt
yourself!
Trainer, stop her!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Their pleas vie for my attention. This one
decision could determine
Dia's fate as a
runner.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I need to ground myself. What's our first
priority? Why did she offer
me her hand in
the first place?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's been a number of days since my fateful
decision. The test is finally
upon us.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
...!
Satono, you're... you're covered in dirt.
Are you certain you're fit to
run?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I see you're too focused to hear me. Very
well, so long as you're in
running
condition.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Use this race to show me how far you've
come. Naturally, I won't hold
back.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
(I've done everything I can—everything I
must. All that's left...)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: (...Is to show McQueen what I can do!)
